features.name: Expertise
features.description: You gain Expertise in two of your skill proficiencies of your choice. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those skills. At Rogue level 6 you gain Expertise in two more skills.

choices.prompt: Choose two skills to gain Expertise

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or Ranged weapon. The extra damage is a number of d6s equal to your Sneak Attack dice. You don't need Advantage if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't Incapacitated, and you don't have Disadvantage on the roll.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You picked up various languages in the communities where you plied your roguish talents, including Thieves' Cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Daggers and Shortbows. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose.

choices.prompt: Choose two weapons whose mastery property you can use

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Your quick thinking and agility allow you to move and act nimbly. On each of your turns in combat, you can take one of the following actions as a Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn. You can use this Bonus Action only if you haven't moved during this turn, and after you use it, your Speed is 0 until the end of the current turn.

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.description: You gain a Roguish Archetype subclass of your choice, such as Thief. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Rogue levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Rogue level or lower.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can add one of the following Cunning Strike effects (Poison, Trip, or Withdraw). Each effect has a die cost, which is the number of Sneak Attack dice you must forgo to add it; you subtract that number from the Sneak Attack dice before rolling.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you (round down).

features.name: Expertise
features.description: You gain Expertise in two more of your skill proficiencies of your choice.

choices.prompt: Choose two more skills to gain Expertise

features.name: Evasion
features.description: You can nimbly dodge out of the way of certain dangers. When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the save and only half damage if you fail.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: Whenever you make an ability check that uses one of your skill or tool proficiencies, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Roguish Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Roguish Archetype subclass.

features.name: Weapon Mastery (Improved)
features.description: You can now use the mastery properties of three kinds of weapons with which you have proficiency.

features.name: Deft Strike
features.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can now use up to two of the Cunning Strike effects, paying the die cost of each.

features.name: Roguish Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Roguish Archetype subclass.

features.name: Devious Strikes
features.description: You have practiced new ways to use your Cunning Strike, gaining the Daze, Knock Out, and Obscure Cunning Strike effects.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: Your cunning mind is exceptionally difficult to control. You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Roguish Archetype Feature
features.description: You gain a feature from your Roguish Archetype subclass.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: You're so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand against you. No attack roll can have Advantage against you unless you're Incapacitated.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: You have an uncanny knack for succeeding when you need to. If you fail a d20 Test, you can turn the roll into a 20. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
